integration.denial: Pushing the local integration commit to a remote branch is an external commitment, and the transcript authorizes relaying the pin but does not clearly authorize this exact remote mutation.
integration.pendingAction: Resolve explicit exact final branch/ref fast-forward authority after local seal; denied action never executed and is not retried

allocation.denial: This publishes a new commit to a remote repository, an external commitment not explicitly authorized by the user for this exact branch/ref.
